registration.title: Registration
registration.help: Who may create an account on this installation.
registration.first_user_onlyHelp: Only the first account could register itself. New accounts are created by administrators.
registration.openHelp: Anyone who can reach this server may register. Use only on a trusted network.

users.title: Users
users.help: Accounts on this installation. Each user sees only their own data.
users.deleteBody: The account and all of its data — conversations, prompts, knowledge, uploads and connections — will be permanently deleted.

urlPolicy.title: Connection addresses
urlPolicy.help: Connections make this server send requests to the address a user enters. Limit what non-administrators may use. Administrators are never restricted.
urlPolicy.label: Allowed for users
urlPolicy.privateHelp: Loopback, private (e.g. 192.168.x.x) and link-local addresses only.
urlPolicy.customHelp: Only the host names and networks listed below.
urlPolicy.anyHelp: No restriction. Users could make this server reach internal services.
urlPolicy.allowlistHelp: One per line: a host name (gpu-box.lan) or a network (10.0.0.0/8).

create.title: Add user
create.help: Leave the password empty to generate a temporary one that must be changed at first sign-in.

temporary.title: Temporary password
temporary.body: Give this password to {{username}} through a safe channel. It is shown only once and must be changed at the next sign-in.
